constraints.rule: alpha_Psi and alpha_B limits must recover GR/LambdaCDM/SM baseline behavior
new stress-energy terms need divergence behavior or explicit exchange law
all physical terms must share compatible units
low-energy SM behavior must not be disrupted without evidence
cosmology limit must recover baseline expansion where couplings vanish
gravitational-wave propagation changes require extreme caution and comparator constraints
scalar couplings must be tested against fifth-force/equivalence anchors
